## findings
- **F0-1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (cross-difficulty evidence contradicts its owning charter)**
  - Symptom: the scored refill (45 units, 60 supply days) takes supply_alignment tier 1 from the continence refill of 2026-09-14, seeded with supply_days 90 / units 360.
  - Root cause: that continence refill draws on the only continence grant, valid through 2026-11-30, which is 77 days after its ship date. continence.yaml `continence_evt_refill_shipment` (lines 1088–1089) requires "the supply days of a shipment are the tier's supply_days_per_shipment, shortened to the whole 30-day blocks that remain before the authorization's valid-through date when fewer remain", which gives 60 days.
  - Evidence:
    - initial_state.continence_shipments (ship_date 2026-09-14, supply_days 90, continence_order_id = grant valid_through 2026-11-30);
    - initial_state.continence_orders grant (valid_from 2025-12-01, valid_through 2026-11-30);
    - ostomy.extended.yaml ostomy_ext_refill_units supply_alignment (lines 3071–3074, compute `cont_left`, `supply_days`).
  - Demonstrated consequence: with the charter-consistent 60 days, the continence supply ends 2026-11-13, 30 days from 2026-10-14. Tier 1 then gives 30 supply days, so covered 20 + extra 5 − on hand 5 = **20 units**. Gold is 45 units / 60 days. GT's EC note "The counted continence refills are genuine refills of the active program under its grant" does not address the supply-day violation.
  - Affected: initial_state continence_shipments row of 2026-09-14 (and its claim row, 360 units / 666.00), the refill's supply_days/units, and computations[refill].
  - Relation to previous revisions: first audit revision.
- **F0-2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (no honest method factor in the hardship waiver computation)**
  - Cites `_difficulty.md` § findings C2, member 2. hardship_waiver's only `method` factor, cap_window, varies only the window length (12/18/24 months) inside the same SUM.
  - On this world it takes the 12-month tier (enrolled 44 months). Substituting the 24-month baseline gives 3.50 instead of 17.50, so the factor bears weight, but as a parameter.
  - Consequence: the waiver computation has 6 parameter factors and 0 method factors, below "at least 1 labelled `method` (… changes how the quantity is computed)".
  - Affected: ostomy.extended.yaml lines 2540–2559; computations[waiver].
- F0-3 — observation (C2 member 3): the notice computation's increase_blocks is a parameter labelled method. The notice keeps 2 honest methods, so its counts hold.
- O-T0-1 — observation (same class as F0-1, own category, load-bearing): the previous A4407 refill of 2026-07-15 (90 days / 75 units) drew on a grant valid through 2026-09-07 (54 days). Both the base and extended supply-day rules give 30 days. The 2025-07-14 A4407 and A4427 refills (grants valid through 2025-09-08) likewise carry 90 days. usage_pace, supply_start and days_left read the 2026-07-15 row as recorded.
- Observations O6 (edge condition clause) and O1 (confirmation and signing overwrites retire nothing): see `_difficulty.md`. Both hold harmlessly on this world (past due 67.50 after the waiver).
